organization: USTC (Pan group; Lin, Li, Rui, Chen, Lu, Pan et al.)
notes: Sustaining high-fidelity quantum logic in neutral-atom circuits via mid-circuit operations. Two-qubit controlled gate at raw 99.60(1)% fidelity, increased to 99.81(1)% via non-destructive erasure detection; fidelities held stable at ~99.8% across multiple operational rounds without observable degradation, using in-circuit Raman sideband cooling and qubit re-initialization (active entropy management against motional heating and atom loss). Below the Helios frontier (99.921%) so NOT a fidelity record. RELEVANCE 4/5: directly applicable to MULTI-LAYER neutral-atom MERA circuits, which require sustained fidelity across many layers and the repeated syndrome-extraction cycles this architecture targets. Does not change physics anchors. discovered_by hardware-tracker 2026-06-11.
